verdict.why: wrangler now detects nub as a package manager, changing which package manager it assumes and uses for nub projects.

draft.detail: wrangler now detects nub from its npm_config_user_agent and an installed nub binary

test.error: FAIL: with a nub npm_config_user_agent and a nub binary, wrangler init ran npm instead of nub

source.quote: wrangler now detects nub — from its `npm_config_user_agent` and an installed `nub` binary — and autoconfig detects nub projects by their `nub.lock`, alongside npm, pnpm, yarn, and bun.
